stories.title: Takeaways from NFL preseason Week 2: QB questions linger for Browns, Vikings, Falcons
stories.summary: NFL Nation reporters tackle the biggest looming roster questions coming off each NFL Week 2 preseason game.

stories.title: Browns' Watson: Boos 'personal,' not based on play
stories.summary: Browns quarterback Deshaun Watson was booed in his first home game since suffering a right Achilles tendon injury in October 2024 and said he thought the reaction from the crowd was "disrespectful" and felt "personal."

stories.title: M's Anderson solid in debut; Arozarena walks it off
stories.summary: Rookie Kade Anderson had an up-and-down debut, allowing three runs in 5⅔ innings for the Mariners, who won 5-4 over the Cubs on Randy Arozarena's walk-off, two-run home run in the ninth.

stories.title: Skubal fans 11 to score first win with Dodgers
stories.summary: Tarik Skubal started out shaky, putting the Los Angeles Dodgers in a 3-0 hole in the first inning Saturday, but the two-time Cy Young Award winner rebounded, leading the two-time defending World Series champions to a 4-3 win over the Pittsburgh Pirates.

stories.title: Bills star DT Oliver mourning tragic death of son
stories.summary: The 2-year-old son of Bills defensive tackle Ed Oliver died June 28 after he was found unresponsive in a swimming pool by family members at a residence outside Houston.
